description: This file defines the 'Shortcuts' class for managing shortcut items in the Notesnook project, including methods for adding, resolving, and removing shortcuts, and handling related data types.

classes.name: Shortcuts
classes.description: Class for managing shortcut items, including adding, resolving, and deleting shortcuts, with internal caching and database interactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new shortcut, with validation and merging existing shortcuts.

methods.name: resolved
methods.description: Resolves shortcut IDs to full Notebook or Tag objects, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a shortcut exists by ID.
